items.label: Editor's Notes
items.value: This 30mm Anita Lille features three-hand movement and a sunray dial with numerals at the 12 and 6 o'clock positions and crystals marking the remaining hours. It is finished with a 12mm steel mesh strap.

items.label: Case & Movement
items.value: 30mm case, 12mm band width, scratch resistant mineral crystal, accurate Quartz movement with 2-hand analog display, imported

items.label: Dial
items.value: Silver, round sleek stainless steel case, with a silver dial and crystal accents.

items.label: Watch Band
items.value: Silver, durable stainless steel mesh band with a secure safety buckle closure that is self adjustable for a customized fit.

items.label: Water Resistant
items.value: Up to 30m (100 ft): Will withstand splashes in water; 3 ATM.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: 3 ATM Water Resistant, Stainless Steel Mesh bracelet, Three Hand Analog
